title: MindMemOS Skill · Run logs
description: Training run logs exported by mindmemos_skill through OTLP to ClickHouse. Counts represent received records, not guaranteed delivery.

list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT LogAttributes['algorithm.project_id'] FROM otel_logs WHERE ServiceName = 'mindmemos-skill' AND LogAttributes['algorithm.project_id'] != '' ORDER BY 1

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT LogAttributes['algorithm.run_id'] FROM otel_logs WHERE ServiceName = 'mindmemos-skill' AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR LogAttributes['algorithm.project_id'] IN (${project:singlequote})) AND LogAttributes['algorithm.run_id'] != '' ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 100

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS logs FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'mindmemos-skill' AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR LogAttributes['algorithm.project_id'] IN (${project:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${run:singlequote}) OR LogAttributes['algorithm.run_id'] IN (${run:singlequote}))

SELECT count() AS errors FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'mindmemos-skill' AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR LogAttributes['algorithm.project_id'] IN (${project:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${run:singlequote}) OR LogAttributes['algorithm.run_id'] IN (${run:singlequote})) AND SeverityText IN ('ERROR', 'CRITICAL')

panels.title: Runs with logs
panels.description: Distinct run IDs observed in the selected time range; this is not the number currently executing.

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(LogAttributes['algorithm.run_id']) AS runs FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'mindmemos-skill' AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR LogAttributes['algorithm.project_id'] IN (${project:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${run:singlequote}) OR LogAttributes['algorithm.run_id'] IN (${run:singlequote}))

SELECT toUnixTimestamp64Milli(maxOrNull(Timestamp)) AS latest FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'mindmemos-skill' AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR LogAttributes['algorithm.project_id'] IN (${project:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${run:singlequote}) OR LogAttributes['algorithm.run_id'] IN (${run:singlequote}))

SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, SeverityText AS severity, count() AS logs FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'mindmemos-skill' AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR LogAttributes['algorithm.project_id'] IN (${project:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${run:singlequote}) OR LogAttributes['algorithm.run_id'] IN (${run:singlequote})) GROUP BY time, severity ORDER BY time

SELECT LogAttributes['algorithm.project_id'] AS project_id, LogAttributes['algorithm.run_id'] AS run_id, count() AS logs, countIf(SeverityText IN ('ERROR', 'CRITICAL')) AS errors, max(Timestamp) AS last_log FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'mindmemos-skill' AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR LogAttributes['algorithm.project_id'] IN (${project:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${run:singlequote}) OR LogAttributes['algorithm.run_id'] IN (${run:singlequote})) GROUP BY project_id, run_id ORDER BY last_log DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Recent logs · trace correlation
panels.description: Body may contain task text at debug capture level. TraceId and SpanId identify the related trace.

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp, SeverityText, LogAttributes['algorithm.project_id'] AS project_id, LogAttributes['algorithm.run_id'] AS run_id, Body, TraceId, SpanId FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'mindmemos-skill' AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR LogAttributes['algorithm.project_id'] IN (${project:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${run:singlequote}) OR LogAttributes['algorithm.run_id'] IN (${run:singlequote})) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
